# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the course script. Chapters are added to `_quarto.yml` under
`book.chapters` as they are converted.

Every chapter ends with a **Self-check** section: 5–8 questions (multiple
choice, short answer, and one applied/scenario question tied to the chapter's
practice box), each marked with the section it tests and a difficulty tag.
Answers are **not** shown in the script — they live in the source-only
`answers/` directory and are exported as a Canvas quiz, linked at the top of
each Self-check section.

::: {.content-visible when-meta="annotations"}
::: {.callout-tip}
## Annotations are enabled

You can highlight and annotate any passage of this script with Hypothesis —
see [How to annotate](appendix/how-to-annotate.qmd) for what counts as a
substantive contribution and how contributions are credited.
:::
:::
